description: This file defines configuration-related flags for the Cuttlefish project, including interface classes and component registration functions for dependency injection.

classes.name: SystemImageDirFlag
classes.description: An interface class for a system image directory flag, inherits from FlagFeature, providing a Path() method.

classes.name: ConfigFlag
classes.description: An empty implementation class inheriting from FlagFeature, representing a configuration flag.

methods.name: ConfigFlagComponent
methods.description: Creates and returns a fruit dependency injection component including SystemImageDirFlag and ConfigFlag.

methods.name: ConfigFlagPlaceholder
methods.description: Creates and returns a fruit component with only ConfigFlag, acting as a placeholder.
